title: Prospective evaluation of a large language model clinical decision support system in the emergency department
summary: Prospective evaluation of a large language model clinical decision support system in the emergency department Nature
body: Prospective evaluation of a large language model clinical decision support system in the emergency department Nature
summaryZh: Nature发表了一项关于大模型在急诊科临床决策支持系统中的前瞻性评估研究，探讨了AI在医疗场景下的实际应用效果与安全性。原始信息显示：Prospective evaluation of a large language model clinical decision support system in the emergency department Nature。该消息由Nature发布，主题为“Prospective evaluation of a large language model clinical decision support system in the emergency department”。其重要性主要体现在：该研究通过前瞻性评估验证了大模型在急诊临床决策支持系统中的实际效能，具有较高的学术与应用价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
